title: Cost and ROI Review
seo: AI cost and ROI review before you commit
meta: An honest estimate of what an AI project costs and what it could save, before you spend. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Know the cost and likely savings before you commit
overview: Before you sign up for a tool or hire a builder, see the numbers. We take one idea you are considering and work out setup cost, monthly running cost, staff time to manage it and the time or money it could save. The result is a short report with low, likely and high estimates and the assumptions behind them, so you can decide with eyes open.

faq: How reliable are the savings estimates?
They are only as good as the figures you give us, so we show ranges and list every assumption. The review is a decision aid, and real savings depend on how it is used.
What information do you need from me?
Roughly how long the task takes, how often it happens, who does it and what that time costs. We send a short sheet to fill in, and rough figures are fine.
Yes. We include training time, monthly subscriptions, usage fees, checking of results and the cost of mistakes, which are often left out of tool marketing.
Will you tell me not to do a project?
If the numbers do not support it, we say so. A clear no saves more money than a weak yes, and we do not earn anything from your tool choice.
